method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Warm the wholemeal flatbread in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 30–60 seconds on each side, until flexible. Keep it covered on a clean plate.

Press the 5% beef mince firmly into three short koftas, each no thicker than 1.5cm; no skewers or binder are needed. After handling raw 5% beef mince, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the beef koftas over a medium heat for about 10–12 minutes, turning them onto every side. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.

Put the measured reduced-sugar BBQ sauce into a small saucepan. Warm over a low heat, stirring, for about 2–3 minutes until bubbling and hot throughout; follow a longer cooking time on the sauce label. Keep warm for serving.
Put the lettuce and tomato on the warm flatbread. Add the cooked beef koftas and the warm sauce, fold the bread around the filling and serve immediately.

review.notes: Three browned beef-mince koftas, shredded raw lettuce, sliced raw tomato and BBQ sauce in folded unseeded wholemeal flatbread. No skewer, extra garnish or sauces; correct finished preparation with useful central crop.
